description.zh:
模板查询时的地域过滤条件。 

> 如果设置了该参数， 则查询出的结果会把其他不匹配的地域化配置屏蔽。
description.en:
The region filter condition for the template query. 

> If this parameter is specified, region-specific configurations that do not match are excluded from the query results.

description.zh: > 该参数暂不对外开放使用。
description.en: > This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh: 云电脑镜像ID，可以从镜像管理页面查询，支持系统镜像、自定义镜像等类型。
description.en: The cloud computer image ID. You can obtain the ID from the image management page. System images, custom images, and other image types are supported.

description.zh: 关键字。支持模糊搜索模板ID、模板名称字段。
description.en: The keyword. Fuzzy match is supported for the template ID and template name fields.

description.zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码。
description.en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页最大行数。
description.en: The maximum number of rows per page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging.
The product type. Set this parameter to `CloudDesktop`.
The list of template IDs to query.
The template name used for the query.

description.zh: 指定查询的模板类型，不传则表示查询所有类型的模板。
description.en: The templatetype to query. If this parameter is not specified, templates of all types are queried.
